scope: Independent source review of interactive signed-in, non-extension-admin path; no browser execution or live database read by this reviewer
A_runtime_unverified: The actual UI login, Chrome extension sign-in, canonical admin response, organization choice, and Files/Saved captures behavior still require a bounded native browser run. Source review cannot turn these into a pass.

The CDP observer assumes the browser emits Accept-Profile in Network.requestWillBeSent request headers and that Network.getResponseBody succeeds after loadingFinished. A missing header or body makes the role proof fail, so a run will test this assumption.

The picker path establishes a selected active organization through the extension's membership-backed UI. The source review does not prove the live membership response or any particular organization role.
B_source_quality_verdict: Suitable for a diagnostic native member run with no source-visible nonadmin false pass. A bounded-pass must still be checked against the live run receipt. The runner's member label means signed in and not assigned as an extension admin; it does not claim an exact organization IAM role.
evidence: Interactive mode requires FILES_SAVED_ROLE=member, no fixture mode, and reviewer_email_fingerprint=3d6137db6c081c07. The reviewer signs in on the normal headed /login page; /api/whoami must yield the fingerprint-matched email, which must then match the extension Account email.
The native harness creates a new temporary Chrome profile and loads the pinned extension build. The runner attaches the network observer before clicking the extension's Sign in UI.

Production checkIsAdmin calls adminDb().from('admins').select('user_id').eq('user_id', userId).limit(1); adminDb uses the admin schema. The observer accepts only that GET shape on the configured Supabase origin, with Accept-Profile admin and a UUID user_id filter.

The observer compares the request user_id to the signed-in extension profile UUID. Only HTTP 200 with a parsed empty JSON array satisfies nonadmin proof. A returned admin row fails; missing, failed, mismatched-user, non-200, and invalid-body responses cannot satisfy the proof.

The interactive organization branch requires no preselected organization, waits for an actual UI choice, and observes the resulting stored active ID. Settings options come from listMemberOrganizations via mbr_for_user; the runner does not substitute an approved admin organization.

The report contains a fingerprint, boolean identity and membership observations, HTTP status, and row count; it does not record the email, password, bearer token, response body, or request headers. Browser authentication is not injected into Chrome.
required_next_evidence: Run the frozen native runner as the fingerprint-matched ordinary signed-in reviewer and inspect its bounded receipt, including the canonical_extension_admin_check observation and chosen organization.
